rules.statement: The RTL shall comply with REF-003, which is the mandatory RTL authority.
Synchronizer flip-flops and technology cells shall exist only in m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync.
m_vlsit_afifo_sync shall contain only instances of m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync.
The memory macro shall exist only in m_vlsit_afifo_ram_macro.

rules.condition: In synthesis, lint, CDC, formal and equivalence flows
rules.statement: These flows shall define the macro VLSIT_SYNTHESIS.
m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync shall instantiate the library cells when VLSIT_SYNTHESIS is defined, and contain the behavioral simulation model with metastability model when it is not.
VLSIT_SYNTHESIS shall select branches only in m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync; m_vlsit_afifo_ram_macro has no branch and always instantiates VLSIT_CELL_SRAM_1W1R.
The flag, Gray register and pointer registers shall be one-process-per-state elements with separate next-state logic.
The software reset FSMs shall be one-process-per-state with separate next-state logic, REF-003 FSM naming, and reside in m_vlsit_afifo_wr and m_vlsit_afifo_rd.
Request and acknowledge synchronizers shall be m_vlsit_afifo_sync instances with PARA_AFIFO_SYNC_W = 1.
o_sw_rst_busy shall be the output of its own flip-flop reg_sw_rst_busy, not a decode of the FSM state.
Names in m_vlsit_afifo_* modules shall use REF-003 NAM-08 abbreviations and be at most 30 characters.
Instance names shall be u_ followed by the module name with m_ removed; names over 30 characters shall shorten the function part with NAM-08.
The top shall have no logic; state is owned by m_vlsit_afifo_wr and m_vlsit_afifo_rd.
Library wrappers and example cells shall be in common_rtl/000_Common, and each folder shall have its own filelist.f.
m_vlsit_afifo_sync shall instantiate PARA_AFIFO_SYNC_W cell wrappers, one per bit, with PARA_AFIFO_CELL_TYPE and the bit's reset flavour, in both VLSIT_SYNTHESIS branches, and nothing else.
Input bit i_data[i] shall connect to i_d and o_q shall be o_data[i].
Option 0 is a bypass (o_q = i_d, 0 stages); options 1 and 2 give 2 stages, option 3 gives 3, option 4 gives 4, with metastability-model chains in simulation.
PARA_AFIFO_CELL_TYPE above 4 shall not be used; the wrapper gives the option 4 cell and behavior is undefined.
Every flop of a synchronizer model shall reset to the reset value bit.
Option 0 shall not be used for the pointer crossings of this IP because it breaks the read margin of at least 2 destination edges.
The synthesis branch shall instantiate the cells of 000_Common/rtl_cells named u_dont_touch_.
The simulation branch shall not use the example cells and shall contain the metastability model with random extra latency of REQ-VER-001.
The synthesis branch shall be verified with VLSIT_SYNTHESIS defined per option, and the simulation branch alone per option (latency 0, 2, 2, 3, 4 and reset value).
The latencies of Section 10.3 and read margin of Section 10.4 shall hold for options 1 to 4.
